before.name: Adam Durand
before.description: Adam Durand is an animal-rights advocate and videographer who documented conditions at Wegmans Egg Farm and participated in rescuing hens. He was convicted of trespass and jailed in 2006. In a later interview he described his confinement and release during the appeal process.
